title: Heat kernels on Cayley graphs of free products of finite groups
summary: We obtain explicit formulas for heat kernels of the normalized Laplacians for two infinite families of Cayley graphs. The first family corresponds to free products of finite groups $G=G_1*\dots*G_r$, with $r\ge2$, and where all factors $G_i$ have the same order $L\ge2$. The second family corresponds to free products of two arbitrary nontrivial finite groups $G*H$ of unequal order. In both families, the generating set consists of all non-identity elements in each factor.
